annotations.title: Find a Live x402 API for a Task

description: Which x402 API should I call for this task? Returns up to 5 paid APIs from Coinbase Bazaar and Agentic Market that answered a fresh unpaid probe with a valid Base USDC payment challenge at their listed price, ranked by repeat buyers rather than one-off probe payments, each with a ready-to-call request. The search runs before settlement: if no live match is found the payment is not settled. Agent payment guidance: run free can-pay and readiness checks first; pay only when policy allows base 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913 and 0.005 USDC is inside the agent budget. [PAID: 0.005 USDC via x402 on Base. Two-step flow: call without payment to receive MCP PaymentRequired, then retry with params._meta['x402/payment'] containing the signed PaymentPayload. The legacy _x402_payment base64 argument is also supported. Sign only after explicit budget and policy approval.]

_x402_payment.description: base64 x402 PaymentPayload (USDC on Base); obtain the requirements by calling this tool without it first.

limit.description: Number of live-verified APIs to return, 1 to 5.

max_usdc.description: Optional per-call price ceiling in USDC for returned APIs, e.g. '0.01'.

task.description: Public task text, e.g. 'web search for an AI agent'. Never include credentials or private data.

name: ontario_find-api
title: Find a Live x402 API for a Task

x402.not_for: Not a safety certification or a guarantee that the paid response is correct. Ontario's own paid routes are excluded from results.
x402.purchase_reason: Avoid paying a ghost or broken listing: get live-checked, repeat-buyer ranked APIs for one task with the exact request and payment terms.
x402.selection_rule: Pay when the agent needs a paid API for a concrete task and wants only endpoints that are payable right now. The free tool router returns unverified search candidates; this tool probes them and drops dead, mismatched or over-budget listings.
